oracles: bin-residuals: reference with SEL-2 broken, idle timeout ignored, two responses -> red
crdb-live: reference that answers a 40001 as success with stale data -> red; cancel ignored -> red
otlp: https endpoint skipped -> red; no retry -> red
proxy-e2e: two responses for one bad chunked request -> red

acceptance.cmd: oracles/bin-residuals/run --self-test && ci/remote.sh --host kamrui bash -c 'ci/engines.sh with crdb -- oracles/crdb-live/run --self-test --dsn @crdb' && oracles/otlp-export/run --self-test
acceptance.must: new oracles bin-residuals, crdb-live (own-gate needs), native-e2e --engine mariadb, otlp-export https+retry cases, proxy-e2e one-response case; each red today against the current binary where the residual exists
